public_rationale: Musk promised in October 2016 that a Tesla would drive from Los Angeles to New York with no human touch by the end of 2017. Inverse reported in October 2021 that the drive still had not happened. No record turned up of any car doing an intervention-free LA-to-NYC drive before the post. Tesla's own AI software head later called a December 2025 drive the 'world's first fully autonomous coast-to-coast drive', which implies none happened earlier. Delphi's 2015 cross-country trip needed human takeovers. The claim holds.
limitations: The December 2025 'first' statement comes from an interested party and falls outside the target period, so it is used as context only.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: As of January 2023, no car has completed an intervention-free autonomous drive from LA to NYC.

statement.excerpt: in the subsequent six years, no car has yet achieved what Elon Musk promised would soon arrive, an intervention-free drive, without human assistance, from LA to NYC.

from_speaker: what Elon Musk promised would soon arrive
our_interpretation: Plain reading: between Musk's October 2016 promise and the post on 2023-01-18, no car had publicly completed a coast-to-coast drive between Los Angeles and New York with zero human interventions.
Since no such drive is known, the claim is checked through credible sources that describe the drive as not yet done during the period, or that name a later drive as the first.
criteria.support_condition: Sources from the period say the promised drive had not happened, and no record shows an intervention-free LA-to-NYC drive before 2023-01-18.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A credible record of any car completing an intervention-free coast-to-coast LA-to-NYC drive between October 2016 and 2023-01-18.
